entries.subject: RE: Farewell wishes and gift for Beth
entries.body:
Hello everyone,

 

If you haven’t already please add your messages to the Kudoboard <https://www.kudoboard.com/boards/GZ0wHmNW> .

 

If you would like to contribute towards the gifts, please PayPal me via @juliefhickman / juliefcox@gmail.com <mailto:juliefcox@gmail.com>  before Friday 21 August.

 

Many thanks

Julie

 

From: Julie Hickman 
Sent: 05 August 2026 17:03
To: Marie Cooksey <marie.cooksey@admin.ox.ac.uk>; Simon Burford <simon.burford@admin.ox.ac.uk>; Christopher Sanders <christopher.sanders@admin.ox.ac.uk>; James Salas Guillen <james.salas@admin.ox.ac.uk>; Michael O'Sullivan <michael.osullivan@admin.ox.ac.uk>; Athena Artuso <athena.artuso@admin.ox.ac.uk>; Sarah Rowles <sarah.rowles@admin.ox.ac.uk>; Kevin Lelitte <kevin.lelitte@admin.ox.ac.uk>; Susan Pratt <susan.pratt@admin.ox.ac.uk>; Asta Palmer <asta.palmer@admin.ox.ac.uk>; Anthony Kong <anthony.kong@admin.ox.ac.uk>; Marie King <marie.king@admin.ox.ac.uk>; Henry Acheampong <henry.acheampong@admin.ox.ac.uk>; David Johnson <david.johnson@admin.ox.ac.uk>; Nathan Kirwan <nathan.kirwan@admin.ox.ac.uk>; Emma Fitz-Gibbon <emma.fitz-gibbon@admin.ox.ac.uk>; Iyanuloluwa Akinsanya <iyanuloluwa.akinsanya@tss.ox.ac.uk>; Otter Ho <otter.ho@admin.ox.ac.uk>; Michelle Williams <michelle.williams@admin.ox.ac.uk>; Julie Hickman <julie.hickman@admin.ox.ac.uk>
Subject: Farewell wishes and gift for Beth

 

Hello everyone,

 

Beth maternity leave is approaching!  

 

If you would like to contribute towards some gifts which Emma and I are organising, please send funds to me via PayPal @juliefhickman / juliefcox@gmail.com <mailto:juliefcox@gmail.com> .

 

We also have a Kudoboard <https://www.kudoboard.com/boards/GZ0wHmNW>  for you to add any farewell messages/ best wishes/ words of wisdom for tackling new born babies 😊 etc.

 

Please can you sign the kudoboard and transfer any funds before Friday 21 August.

 

Many thanks 

Julie

 

Julie Hickman

HR Systems Trainer
